intro: Diamonds, gold and timber are the main exports, but the country is one of the poorest in the world.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Diamonds and gold are mined, often by hand. Timber, coffee and cotton are exported. In 2022 it became the second country to adopt Bitcoin as legal tender, a policy soon reversed.

chapters.title: Poverty
text: Conflict has kept most people very poor.

keyTerms.meaning: Money that must be accepted for payment.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Central African Republic makes and sells to the world.
